exam: SSC CGL Tier 1 2026 (Staff Selection Commission — Combined Graduate Level)
source_note: Compiled from the SSC's official CGL Tier 1 syllabus/notification as reported by multiple 2025-2026 coaching/exam-tracker sources (PhysicsWallah, Careers360, Adda247, CareerPower, Testbook, LearnTheta, Sreedhar's CCE, Mahendra's), cross-checked Sep 2026. Always verify against the current-year notification at ssc.gov.in before finalising a question bank, since SSC has been known to add procedural changes (e.g. sectional timing) between cycles.
exam_pattern_note: SSC CGL Tier 1 2026: 100 objective MCQs, 200 marks (2 marks per correct question), 60 minutes total, computer-based online test (CBT). Four equally-sized sections of 25 questions / 50 marks each: General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Awareness, Quantitative Aptitude, English Comprehension. From the 2026 cycle, multiple trackers report SSC has introduced SECTIONAL TIMING — 15 minutes per section, with the section auto-closing when its time is up (previously Tier 1 had only an overall 60-minute limit with free movement between sections). Verify this procedural change against the official notification, as not every source has caught up to it yet. Tier 1 is purely qualifying — its marks are NOT added to the final merit list, but candidates must clear the Tier 1 cut-off to sit for Tier 2. Questions are set in both English and Hindi, except the English Comprehension section, which is English-only.

sections.question_format: 5-option single-correct MCQ, verbal and non-verbal reasoning.

subtopics: Indexing, address matching, date & city matching
Critical thinking, emotional intelligence, social intelligence

sections.question_format: 5-option single-correct MCQ, standalone fact-based items (static GK plus current affairs).

subtopics: Interaction between people and the environment
National and international current events (typically last 6-12 months)
Awards, books and authors, sports, notable personalities

sections.question_format: 5-option single-correct MCQ. Not an arithmetic-only section — geometry, mensuration and trigonometry make up a substantial share alongside arithmetic and basic algebra.

subtopics: Whole numbers, decimals, fractions and relationships between numbers
